==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am traveling through time. I do so by jumping into screens. Sometimes I manifest a body at my destination, and sometimes I don't.

I have an official ID that marks me as a member of an adventurer guild. Depending on where and when I am, I either need to present my ID or keep it a secret. The rules are very confusing.

Everytime I arrive through a screen, I have a mission to complete. Missions vary from being really mundane to involving aliens and VR train simulators. I wake up while seemingly in the middle of several different missions at once.

Shortly after I wake up, my UFO detector goes off in the kitchen.
